Frequently asked questions

Is the webinar really free?

Yes. The webinars run live on Zoom and cost nothing to join.

When do I get the Zoom link?

Straight after you register, a Google Calendar invite arrives by email with your Zoom link inside. We also send WhatsApp reminders before the session.

Are the courses online?

No. Our courses are two-day, in-person classes. Only the free webinars are online.

Can my company claim the fee through HRDC?

Our courses are HRDC-claimable. [Programme ID and claim steps to confirm.]

Which language are the sessions in?

Thursday webinars are in English. Tuesday webinars and Jacky Guan's courses are in Mandarin. Every date is tagged English or Chinese.

What happened behind this page

    Connection test: real calendar invite

    Check this. If n8n already sends the calendar invite, this button adds a second copy to their calendar. Decide whether the button is the backup or the only route, and keep just one.

    Prototype only · not part of the live page

    How the sign-up works behind the page

    Updated after the 13 Nov meeting. The page replaces the Meta instant form and WhatsApp two-layer flow. The visitor fills in one form and goes straight to a thank-you page. Everything else happens in n8n, so the lead never registers on Zoom themselves.

    1 · Where visitors come from
    Meta ads
    Social post comments
    Google Ads
    WhatsApp chats
    2 · Two pages on a22a.my
    Step 1: the formOne version per trainer, session pre-selected. Pixel tracks the button click.
    Step 2: thank-you pageOne button: Add to Google Calendar. Pixel counts the conversion.
    3 · Automation (existing VPS)
    n8n workflowReceives the form and runs every step below.
    4 · What n8n does
    Zoom registrationPersonal join link, made for the lead
    Google Calendar inviteSent by email, Zoom link inside
    Google Sheet rowEvery field plus version and source
    Sleekflow contactLabelled by cycle for the scheduled reminder blasts

    Decided on 13 Nov

    • The page runs on the A22A domain, so the pixel can track it.
    • The form takes full name, email, WhatsApp and phone number.
    • The loading step is removed: the form goes straight to the thank-you page.
    • The thank-you page has one button, Add to Google Calendar. No Zoom link or WhatsApp confirmation is shown there.
    • n8n handles the Zoom registration and writes each lead to a Google Sheet.
    • Each version pre-selects its own trainer's session, so Jacky's and Thomas's audiences never mix.

    Who to consult

    1. Thomasn8n integration: Zoom registration, calendar invite and the Google Sheet.
    2. DarylAutomated reminders. Recently built a wedding landing page that sends them.

    Open questions

    • Should the thank-you button be the backup or the only calendar route? Today the n8n invite and the button would both add the event.
    • Jacky's Tuesday session time.

    What it adds to the monthly cost

    n8n on your Hostinger VPSRM0 extra
    Zoom, Google Calendar, Google SheetsRM0 extra
    Sleekflow API calls
    Premium allowance: 200,000    		Under 20%
    of allowance
    WhatsApp confirmation message
    Dropped from the thank-you page    		RM0 if not sent

    Reminder blasts cost what they cost today. If they're billed as marketing messages, sending them as event reminders could save about RM1,920 a month. Check your Sleekflow billing.

    Why it should help

    Today, 37 of every 100 Meta-form leads never register on Zoom, because the link only arrives on Thursday. Here n8n registers them the moment they submit.

    Today
    91 attendees
    Low case
    106
    High case
    135

    Cost per attendee: RM19.24 today, RM16.55 to RM12.93 projected. This assumes 10–30% of the people who never register today attend once registered. It is an assumption, not a measurement.

    Running the ads alongside the page

    • Meta: run a website-leads campaign 50/50 with the instant form for two cycles, optimised on the thank-you page conversion. Page leads need to cost under about RM7.34 to beat today's cost per attendee.
    • Versions: Thomas's ads link to the English version and Jacky's ads to the Mandarin version.
    • Google Ads: point it at the page, with the thank-you page as its conversion.

    Roadmap

    1. 19 NovRun as today: the baseline cycle.
    2. 26 Novn8n live: Zoom, calendar invite, Google Sheet.
    3. 3 DecBoth page versions live, with pixel and source tags.
    4. To 17 DecCompare cycles by source: cost per lead, registration and turn-up.

    Sources: your Obsidian notes "Webinar ad funnel trends" and "A22a website revamp roadmap", the "Funnel" tab of Marketing Hub - A22A, and the 13 Nov landing-page meeting notes. Copy in square brackets is a placeholder. Only the connection test is real: it creates one event on your own Google Calendar and invites the address you enter. Nothing else is saved or sent.
